title_zh: 印度線上 DBT 技能小組對新興成人的可行性與初步療效
title_en: Virtually delivered DBT skills groups among emerging adults in India
summary_zh: 84 名印度新興成人隨機分派至八週視像 DBT 技能訓練小組或等候名單，由學生治療師帶領。保留率 71.8%，學員評價可接受；DBT 組在評估後抑鬱症狀較對照組低，但情緒失調、應對功能與焦慮無顯著差異。研究顯示 DBT 在中低收入國家以遙距方式推行具初步可行性。
summary_en: In an RCT with 84 emerging adults in India, eight weeks of virtually delivered DBT skills groups led by student therapists retained 71.8% of participants and was rated acceptable. The DBT group had lower depression symptoms than the waitlist at post-assessment, but no significant differences in emotion dysregulation, coping or anxiety, suggesting remote DBT is initially feasible in a lower-middle-income setting.
evidence_note: 同儕評審期刊隨機對照試驗（n=84）
caution: 由學生治療師帶領、樣本為印度新興成人；情緒失調與焦慮結果無顯著差異，推論至本地時需謹慎。
brief_zh: 84 名印度新興成人，八週視像 DBT 技能小組

supervision_questions: 遙距 DBT 小組由受訓中的治療師帶領時，督導需要特別留意甚麼？

posts.title: Virtually Delivered DBT Skills Groups Among Emerging Adults in India
posts.content: 研究檢視八週視像 DBT 技能訓練小組對印度新興成人的可行性與初步療效。
